result.finding: The application exposes HTTP/REST APIs via Spring MVC annotations. It also integrates with Spring Cloud Config Server and Eureka Discovery Server over HTTP. No gRPC, WebSocket, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging protocols are used.
evidence: No Kafka, RabbitMQ, gRPC, WebSocket, or JMS dependencies found in pom.xml
